title: Apex Platinum - 0% Intro APR Balance Transfer Rules (2024)
content: Policy Code: BT-001-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: Promotional 0% intro APR applies for 15 billing cycles from account opening on balance transfers requested within 60 days of account creation. A balance transfer fee of 3% or $10 (whichever is greater) applies to each transfer. Standard balance transfer APR ranges from 18.24% to 28.24% variable based on creditworthiness after the intro period ends. Transfers cannot be made between existing Apex accounts.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Balance Transfer Intro Rates (2024)
content: Policy Code: BT-001-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: Promotional 0% intro APR applies for 12 billing cycles on transfers made within 45 days. A balance transfer fee of 4% or $10 applies. Regular APR ranges from 19.99% to 27.99% variable.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - 0% Intro APR Terms (2024)
content: Policy Code: BT-001-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: Promotional 0% intro APR for 18 billing cycles on balance transfers executed within 60 days of opening. Balance transfer fee is 3% or $5 minimum. Post-introductory APR is 17.49% to 26.49% variable.

title: Apex Business Select - Corporate Balance Transfer Guidelines (2024)
content: Policy Code: BT-001-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: Promotional 0% intro APR for 9 billing cycles on transfers submitted within 30 days. Transfer fee is 3% across all transaction sizes. Regular balance transfer APR is 16.99% to 24.99%.

title: Apex Platinum - Balance Transfer Processing Timelines (2025)
content: Policy Code: BT-002-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: Standard balance transfer requests take 5 to 7 business days to process and pay out to external card issuers. Expedited transfers are not available. Payments to external accounts continue to be the cardholder's responsibility until the transferred amount appears on the Apex credit statement.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Balance Transfer Delivery Speed (2025)
content: Policy Code: BT-002-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: Balance transfers require 7 to 10 business days for electronic fund arrival to competitive financial institutions. Cardholders must maintain minimum payments on existing accounts until verified.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Processing Timelines & Confirmations (2025)
content: Policy Code: BT-002-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: Processing times average 5 business days for major US bank payees and up to 10 business days for credit unions. Email notification is dispatched upon disbursement.

title: Apex Business Select - Commercial Transfer Settlement (2025)
content: Policy Code: BT-002-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: Business balance transfers are processed via automated clearing house (ACH) within 3 to 5 business days. Maximum transfer limit per rolling 30-day window is $50,000.

title: Apex Platinum - Interest Allocation & Payment Prioritization (2024)
content: Policy Code: BT-003-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: If a balance transfer amount is not paid off before the introductory period ends, interest accrues daily on the remaining balance from the expiration date onward. Payments above the minimum monthly payment are automatically allocated to the balance with the highest APR first.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Payment Application Hierarchy (2024)
content: Policy Code: BT-003-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: Excess monthly payments apply to regular purchase APR balances prior to low-rate promotional balance transfer balances pursuant to CARD Act regulations.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Expiration & Interest Calculation (2024)
content: Policy Code: BT-003-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: Upon intro APR expiry, residual balances transition to the standard variable balance transfer APR (17.49% to 26.49%). Interest is computed using the average daily balance method.

title: Apex Business Select - Payment Distribution Policy (2024)
content: Policy Code: BT-003-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: Payments exceeding minimum amounts apply to balances with highest interest rates. Promotional balances retain zero-rate standing until expiration date.

title: Apex Platinum - Balance Transfer Limits & Caps (2025)
content: Policy Code: BT-004-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: Total cumulative balance transfer amount cannot exceed 95% of total approved credit line minus transaction fees. Transfers to pay Apex loans or affiliated credit products are strictly prohibited.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Balance Transfer Cap Guidelines (2025)
content: Policy Code: BT-004-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: Balance transfer authorization limit capped at $15,000 per request or 90% of total revolving limit. Transfers cannot be canceled once status shifts to Processing.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Cross-Currency Balance Transfers (2025)
content: Policy Code: BT-005-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: Balance transfers must originate in USD and target US-domiciled financial institutions. International credit card balance transfers are not supported.

title: Apex Platinum - Zero Liability Fraud Protection Policy (2024)
content: Policy Code: FRD-101-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Disputes & Zero Liability Fraud. Details: Apex cardholders incur $0 liability for unauthorized transactions reported within 60 days of the statement date. Unauthorized transactions must be reported immediately via online banking or call center. Temporary credits are issued within 2 business days during investigation.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Zero Liability Coverage (2024)
content: Policy Code: FRD-101-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Disputes & Zero Liability Fraud. Details: Cardholders are protected with 100% fraud coverage for reported unauthorized online or physical point-of-sale transactions. Reporting window is 60 calendar days post statement generation.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Unauthorized Charge Reporting (2024)
content: Policy Code: FRD-101-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Disputes & Zero Liability Fraud. Details: Zero liability applies if reasonable care was taken to protect physical card and card credentials. Notification must be submitted within 60 days of billing date.

title: Apex Business Select - Commercial Fraud Liability (2024)
content: Policy Code: FRD-101-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Disputes & Zero Liability Fraud. Details: Commercial accounts feature $0 liability for unauthorized employee expenditures if reported within 60 days. Requires business administrator verification.

title: Apex Platinum - Merchant Chargeback Dispute Timeline (2024)
content: Policy Code: DIS-102-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Disputes & Zero Liability Fraud. Details: Cardholders may dispute a merchant transaction for billing errors, non-delivery of goods, or defective merchandise within 120 calendar days from the transaction date. Documentation including receipts, cancellation confirmation, and merchant communication logs must be submitted.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Billing Dispute Deadlines (2024)
content: Policy Code: DIS-102-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Disputes & Zero Liability Fraud. Details: Non-delivery of service or incorrect amount disputes must be initiated within 120 days. Supporting documents must be uploaded via the resolution portal.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Merchant Dispute Procedure (2024)
content: Policy Code: DIS-102-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Disputes & Zero Liability Fraud. Details: Cardholders must attempt direct resolution with merchant first. If unresolved, claim must be filed within 120 days from transaction posting date.

title: Apex Business Select - B2B Chargeback Requirements (2024)
content: Policy Code: DIS-102-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Disputes & Zero Liability Fraud. Details: Commercial purchase disputes require invoice, purchase order, and written merchant refusal. Filing deadline is 120 calendar days.

title: Apex Platinum - Provisional Credit Allocation Rules (2025)
content: Policy Code: DIS-103-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Disputes & Zero Liability Fraud. Details: A provisional credit will be credited to the customer account within 10 business days for disputed billing amounts greater than $25. If the investigation resolves in favor of the merchant, the provisional credit will be revoked with a 10-day advance notification to the cardholder.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Provisional Credit Terms (2025)
content: Policy Code: DIS-103-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Disputes & Zero Liability Fraud. Details: Temporary provisional credits post within 10 business days for eligible claims over $25. Reversal occurs if merchant provides proof of valid charge.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Disputed Amount Credit Timelines (2025)
content: Policy Code: DIS-103-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Disputes & Zero Liability Fraud. Details: Provisional credits applied within 10 business days for transactions exceeding $25 threshold. Final disposition notification sent by mail or portal.

title: Apex Business Select - Corporate Provisional Credit Rules (2025)
content: Policy Code: DIS-103-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Disputes & Zero Liability Fraud. Details: Commercial disputes above $50 qualify for provisional credit within 5 business days. Revocation notice provided 10 days prior if charge validated.

title: Apex Platinum - Fraud Notification & Card Lock Rules (2025)
content: Policy Code: FRD-104-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Disputes & Zero Liability Fraud. Details: Automated fraud triggers place temporary lock on account when suspicious activity is flagged. Cardholder must confirm transaction via SMS or mobile app within 2 hours to prevent card reissuance.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Fraud Alert Safeguards (2025)
content: Policy Code: FRD-104-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Disputes & Zero Liability Fraud. Details: Real-time fraud detection suspends card upon detection of abnormal geographic patterns. Phone verification required to unblock.

title: Apex Business Select - Employee Abuse & Fraud Coverage (2025)
content: Policy Code: FRD-105-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Disputes & Zero Liability Fraud. Details: Commercial liability protection covers unauthorized employee usage up to $25,000 per cardholder provided business maintains internal control protocols.

title: Apex Platinum - Annual Fee Billing and Refund Waiver Rules (2024)
content: Policy Code: FEE-201-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Fees & Interest (APR). Details: Apex Platinum card annual fee is $495 billed on the anniversary month of account opening. The annual fee is fully refundable if the account is closed within 30 days of the fee posting date. Fee waivers cannot be authorized by Tier 1 agents unless a retention offer promotion code is active in CRM.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Annual Fee & Refund Conditions (2024)
content: Policy Code: FEE-201-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Fees & Interest (APR). Details: Annual fee is $95 charged annually on anniversary date. Full refund provided if account cancelled within 30 days of fee posting. No fee waivers permitted without active retention flag.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - No Annual Fee Guarantee (2024)
content: Policy Code: FEE-201-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Fees & Interest (APR). Details: Apex Everyday Freedom features $0 annual fee. No maintenance or membership fees apply for standard account operation.

title: Apex Business Select - Commercial Annual Fee Structure (2024)
content: Policy Code: FEE-201-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Fees & Interest (APR). Details: Annual fee is $250 for primary card plus $50 per additional employee card. Pro-rated refunds are not issued upon mid-year card cancellation.

title: Apex Platinum - Foreign Transaction Fee Structure (2024)
content: Policy Code: FEE-202-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Fees & Interest (APR). Details: Apex Platinum cards carry a $0 foreign transaction fee on all international purchases and transactions processed outside the United States.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Foreign Transaction Exemptions (2024)
content: Policy Code: FEE-202-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Fees & Interest (APR). Details: Apex Preferred Travel card features $0 foreign transaction fee on all purchases made in foreign currencies or overseas merchants.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Foreign Transaction Fee Rules (2024)
content: Policy Code: FEE-202-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Fees & Interest (APR). Details: Apex Everyday Freedom cards incur a 3% foreign transaction fee on all purchases made in foreign currencies or processed through non-US acquiring banks.

title: Apex Business Select - Foreign Transaction Policy (2024)
content: Policy Code: FEE-202-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Fees & Interest (APR). Details: Apex Business Select carries a 1% foreign transaction fee on converted commercial foreign transactions.

title: Apex Platinum - Late Payment Fee Schedule & Grace Period (2025)
content: Policy Code: FEE-203-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Fees & Interest (APR). Details: Late payment fees are $29 for the first occurrence within 6 billing cycles and $40 for subsequent occurrences. Payments submitted after 5:00 PM EST on the payment due date are considered late. Interest grace period is 21 days for purchase balances if previous cycle balance was paid in full.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Late Fee & Cutoff Times (2025)
content: Policy Code: FEE-203-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Fees & Interest (APR). Details: Late fee is $29 for first late payment, $40 for repeat violations. Payment cutoff time is 5:00 PM EST on due date. Grace period is 21 days.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Late Payment Assessment (2025)
content: Policy Code: FEE-203-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Fees & Interest (APR). Details: Late payment fee is $29 initial / $40 recurring within 6 months. Cutoff standard is 5:00 PM EST. Interest grace period applies only when zero prior balance exists.

title: Apex Business Select - Commercial Late Fee Structure (2025)
content: Policy Code: FEE-203-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Fees & Interest (APR). Details: Late fee is $39 per late billing cycle. Business payment cutoff is 5:00 PM EST. Grace period extended to 25 days for enterprise accounts.

title: Apex Platinum - Cash Advance APR & Fee Structure (2024)
content: Policy Code: FEE-204-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Fees & Interest (APR). Details: Cash advance fee is 5% or $10 minimum. Cash advance APR is 29.99% variable and begins accruing immediately on withdrawal date without grace period.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Returned Payment Fee Policy (2024)
content: Policy Code: FEE-205-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Fees & Interest (APR). Details: Returned ACH or check payments incur a $35 fee per instance. Repeated returned payments within 3 cycles may result in credit limit reduction.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Penalty APR Regulations (2024)
content: Policy Code: FEE-206-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Fees & Interest (APR). Details: Penalty APR of 29.99% variable applies if payment is 60 days past due. Penalty rate remains in effect until 6 consecutive on-time monthly payments are completed.

title: Apex Platinum - Travel Perk Lounge Access Terms (2024)
content: Policy Code: REW-301-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Rewards & Benefits. Details: Apex Platinum cardholders receive complimentary Priority Pass Select membership. Enrollment is required via the benefits portal. Membership grants access to over 1,300 airport lounges worldwide for the primary cardholder and up to 2 guests. Additional guests are charged $35 per visit.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Lounge Access Terms (2024)
content: Policy Code: REW-301-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Rewards & Benefits. Details: Cardholders receive 2 complimentary airport lounge passes per calendar year via the Apex Travel App. Additional passes available at $32 per person.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Lounge Access Exclusions (2024)
content: Policy Code: REW-301-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Rewards & Benefits. Details: Apex Everyday Freedom cardholders do not receive complimentary lounge access privileges. Single-entry lounge passes can be purchased via app at retail rates.

title: Apex Business Select - Commercial Lounge Privileges (2024)
content: Policy Code: REW-301-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Rewards & Benefits. Details: Primary account owner receives Priority Pass Select membership with 1 complimentary guest. Employee cardholders do not receive independent lounge credentials.

title: Apex Platinum - Points Redemption Value and Expiration (2025)
content: Policy Code: REW-302-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Rewards & Benefits. Details: Apex Rewards points do not expire as long as the account remains open and in good standing. Points redeemed for cash back or statement credit yield a rate of 100 points = $1.00 (1 cent/point). Travel portal redemptions offer a 50% bonus value (100 points = $1.50) for Apex Platinum cardholders.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Reward Redemption Rates (2025)
content: Policy Code: REW-302-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Rewards & Benefits. Details: Points do not expire on active accounts. Cash redemption rate is 100 points = $1.00. Travel portal redemption receives 25% bonus (100 points = $1.25).

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Points Expiration Rules (2025)
content: Policy Code: REW-302-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Rewards & Benefits. Details: Points do not expire with active standing. Cash back valuation is 100 points = $1.00 statement credit. Travel redemption bonuses do not apply to Everyday Freedom.

title: Apex Business Select - Corporate Points Valuation (2025)
content: Policy Code: REW-302-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Rewards & Benefits. Details: Commercial reward points do not expire while account remains open. Points can be redeemed for statement credit (1 cent/point) or cash rebate checks.

title: Apex Platinum - Cell Phone Protection Benefit (2024)
content: Policy Code: REW-303-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Rewards & Benefits. Details: Cardholders paying their monthly cellular telephone bill with an eligible Apex card receive up to $800 per claim ($50 deductible) against theft or damage. Maximum 2 claims per 12-month period. Coverage does not include cosmetic damage or lost phones.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Wireless Protection Policy (2024)
content: Policy Code: REW-303-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Rewards & Benefits. Details: Wireless phone protection provides up to $600 per claim ($50 deductible) when bill is paid using the card. Max 2 claims per 12 months.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Cell Phone Protection Exclusion (2024)
content: Policy Code: REW-303-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Rewards & Benefits. Details: Cell phone damage and theft protection is not included on Apex Everyday Freedom cards.

title: Apex Business Select - Commercial Cell Phone Protection (2024)
content: Policy Code: REW-303-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Rewards & Benefits. Details: Up to $1,000 protection per claim ($100 deductible) for business employee phones paid on primary account. Limit 5 claims per business account annually.

title: Apex Platinum - Annual Travel Credit Administration (2025)
content: Policy Code: REW-304-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Rewards & Benefits. Details: Cardholders receive $300 automatic statement credit per calendar year for eligible flight, hotel, and transit purchases. Unused credits expire December 31.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Annual Hotel Credit (2025)
content: Policy Code: REW-304-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Rewards & Benefits. Details: Includes $50 annual hotel credit applied automatically to bookings completed through the Apex Travel Portal.

title: Apex Platinum - Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit (2025)
content: Policy Code: REW-305-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Rewards & Benefits. Details: Up to $100 statement credit every 4 years for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fees charged to Platinum card.

title: Apex Platinum - Emergency Cash Disbursement & Replacement (2024)
content: Policy Code: EMG-401-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Emergency Services & Card Management. Details: In the event of a lost or stolen card while traveling abroad, Apex Platinum cardholders can request emergency replacement card delivery within 24–48 hours globally. Emergency cash disbursements up to $1,000 USD can be arranged via Western Union within 4 hours.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Overseas Card Replacement (2024)
content: Policy Code: EMG-401-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Emergency Services & Card Management. Details: Emergency card delivery within 48 to 72 hours overseas. Emergency cash payout available up to $500 USD within 12 hours.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Replacement Card Timelines (2024)
content: Policy Code: EMG-401-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Emergency Services & Card Management. Details: Standard domestic replacement delivered in 3-5 business days. International emergency replacement available in 3-5 days with a $20 rush delivery fee.

title: Apex Business Select - Commercial Emergency Services (2024)
content: Policy Code: EMG-401-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Emergency Services & Card Management. Details: Expedited 24-hour global replacement for corporate cardholders. Emergency cash advance available up to $2,500.

title: Apex Platinum - Credit Limit Increase Eligibility Rules (2025)
content: Policy Code: EMG-402-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Emergency Services & Card Management. Details: Cardholders can request a credit limit increase after 6 months of active account history without late payments. Soft credit inquiries are performed for standard line increases. Hard inquiries are required for requested line increases exceeding 50% of the current credit limit.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Credit Line Review Policy (2025)
content: Policy Code: EMG-402-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Emergency Services & Card Management. Details: Account must be active for 6 months before credit limit increase evaluation. Soft pull used for standard increases up to 30% of limit.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Credit Increase Rules (2025)
content: Policy Code: EMG-402-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Emergency Services & Card Management. Details: Account tenure minimum is 6 months. Automatic account reviews occur every 12 months for proactive limit updates.

title: Apex Business Select - Corporate Credit Limit Adjustments (2025)
content: Policy Code: EMG-402-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Emergency Services & Card Management. Details: Business accounts require 6 months of payment history and recent business financial statements for line expansion requests.

title: Apex Platinum - Account Freeze & Lock Privileges (2024)
content: Policy Code: EMG-403-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Emergency Services & Card Management. Details: Instant toggle freeze via mobile app blocks new purchases while allowing recurring subscriptions and automated monthly payments to process uninterrupted.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Digital Card Freeze Controls (2024)
content: Policy Code: EMG-403-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Emergency Services & Card Management. Details: Mobile app card freeze takes effect immediately upon activation. ATM transactions and retail swipes are instantly declined.

title: Apex Platinum - Travel Notification & Security Overrides (2025)
content: Policy Code: EMG-404-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Emergency Services & Card Management. Details: Travel notifications are recommended but optional due to real-time chip and tokenization fraud monitoring. Travel plans can be set up to 90 days in advance.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Travel Advisory Registration (2025)
content: Policy Code: EMG-404-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Emergency Services & Card Management. Details: Cardholders can log up to 5 destination countries in app to prevent false-positive fraud declines while traveling.

title: Apex Platinum - Virtual Card Number Generation (2024)
content: Policy Code: EMG-405-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Emergency Services & Card Management. Details: Unlimited dynamic virtual card numbers can be generated via mobile app for secure online vendor transactions with custom spending caps.

title: Apex Business Select - Virtual Employee Card Controls (2024)
content: Policy Code: EMG-405-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Emergency Services & Card Management. Details: Enterprise admins can issue single-use or merchant-locked virtual cards to staff with preset expiration dates.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Rush Delivery Fee Policy (2025)
content: Policy Code: EMG-406-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Emergency Services & Card Management. Details: Domestic expedited replacement delivery (1-2 business days) incurs a $15 courier fee unless waived for fraud reissuance.

title: Apex Platinum - Authorized User Rights and Liability (2024)
content: Policy Code: SEC-501-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Account Security & Authorized Users. Details: Primary cardholders may add up to 4 authorized users for $175 total per year. Primary cardholder retains sole legal liability for all balance amounts accrued by authorized users.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Authorized User Fee Structure (2024)
content: Policy Code: SEC-501-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Account Security & Authorized Users. Details: Authorized users can be added for $0 additional fee. Primary account holder accepts full legal financial responsibility for all purchases.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Authorized User Perks (2024)
content: Policy Code: SEC-501-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Account Security & Authorized Users. Details: Authorized users added at $0 charge. Points earned by authorized user transactions pool directly into primary cardholder account.

title: Apex Business Select - Employee Spending Controls (2024)
content: Policy Code: SEC-501-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Account Security & Authorized Users. Details: Business accounts can assign customized spending limits and merchant category restrictions for each individual employee card.

title: Apex Platinum - Two-Factor Authentication Requirements (2025)
content: Policy Code: SEC-502-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Account Security & Authorized Users. Details: Mandatory 2FA enabled for account changes, address updates, high-value transfers, and baseline digital portal login access.

title: Apex Preferred Travel - Security Authentication Protocol (2025)
content: Policy Code: SEC-502-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Preferred Travel. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Account Security & Authorized Users. Details: Biometric login or SMS passcodes mandatory for online account management and phone-based profile edits.

title: Apex Everyday Freedom - Power of Attorney & Third Party Access (2025)
content: Policy Code: SEC-503-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Account Security & Authorized Users. Details: Third-party legal management requires verified Power of Attorney documentation processed by the Apex Legal Compliance department.

title: Apex Business Select - Role-Based Portal Access (2025)
content: Policy Code: SEC-504-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Account Security & Authorized Users. Details: Admin, Manager, and Viewer permissions can be assigned to corporate portal users without granting card issuing privileges.

title: Apex Platinum - Credit Bureau Reporting & Authorized Users (2024)
